Arrange the following steps involved in the process of organising in logical
sequence
(A) The activities which are similar in nature are grouped together. 
(B) Jobs are allocated to the members of each department in accordance
with their skills and competencies. 
(C) Authority and reporting relationships are established to create a
hierarchal structure. 
(D) The work is divided into manageable activities so that duplication can
be avoided.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
